claim_text: In August 2026, U.S. President Donald Trump posted an image showing a six-fingered U.S. Navy sailor eating a burger with the caption, "OUR MILITARY EATS THE BEST! Nobody feeds our brave troops better than me. The food is AMAZING--the best military food EVER! Other countries wish they could feed their soldiers this well. TOTAL WIN!"
query: U.S. President Donald Trump an image showing a six-fingered U.S. Navy sailor
summary: The story spread as Navy sailors and Marines aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier prepared to land after more than 270 days at sea, receiving widespread attention for deteriorating conditions on board — including reportedly running out of food and other essential supplies. Fake Claim Spreads Online The fake screenshot began circulating on X (formerly Twitter) today, August 31 and quickly spread across other social media platforms, including Facebook and YouTube, purporting to be a genuine post from Donald Trump's Truth Social account. The best thing is no matter how much they eat, they don't get out of shape or lose any bonus digits."
